label: Kyoto · Paths of quiet wonder
description: Fictional Kyoto journal · gates, bamboo and temple views
title: Between vermilion and green
subtitle: Three days in Kyoto, remembered one small moment at a time.

posts.author: traveler
posts.text: We arrived at Fushimi Inari Taisha and walked beneath the vermilion gates. I kept pausing to look up.

posts.author: hana
posts.text: The red gates are the part I want to remember. Let us keep this photo.

posts.author: traveler
posts.text: We walked through the bamboo grove in Arashiyama. We took our time and enjoyed being there together.

posts.author: hana
posts.text: The bamboo made this feel like a different side of Kyoto.

posts.author: traveler
posts.text: We visited Kiyomizu-dera and looked out across Kyoto. It was our last stop before heading home.

posts.author: hana
posts.text: I would love to come back and walk these streets again.

label: Paris · A little time by the Seine
description: Fictional Paris journal · river views and the Louvre
title: A little time by the Seine
subtitle: Two days of looking up, slowing down, and keeping the small things.

posts.author: traveler
posts.text: We stopped beside the Seine to look at the Eiffel Tower. I had seen it in pictures, but wanted a photo of this moment.

posts.author: hana
posts.text: My favorite part was having no hurry to leave the river.

posts.author: traveler
posts.text: We went inside the Louvre Pyramid. We took a photo looking through the glass.

posts.author: hana
posts.text: Let us use the river photo for the cover and keep the Louvre photo in the second chapter.

label: New York · The city, at our pace
description: Fictional New York journal · Brooklyn Bridge and Central Park
title: The city, at our pace
subtitle: From the bridge to the park, two days of finding our own New York.

posts.author: traveler
posts.text: We walked onto Brooklyn Bridge and stopped to look at the Manhattan skyline. This is the photo I wanted to bring home.

posts.author: hana
posts.text: The bridge is my favorite memory of our first day.

posts.author: traveler
posts.text: We spent our second day in Central Park and took a photo beside the lake.

posts.author: hana
posts.text: It felt good to slow down after our walk across the bridge.
